name: Vegetable egg fried rice
summary: Cold brown rice stir-fried hot with egg, peas, sweetcorn, carrot, cabbage, red pepper and spring onion, seasoned with soy sauce, ginger and a little sesame oil.
about: Egg fried rice comes from Chinese home cooking, where it is made with rice cooked the day before: cold grains stay separate and fry instead of turning sticky. It is the natural home for leftover rice and the vegetables in the fridge.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.note: beaten with a pinch of salt

ingredients.name: Spring onions
ingredients.note: sliced, white and green parts kept apart

ingredients.name: Cooked brown rice
ingredients.note: cold, from 1½ cups raw cooked the day before

steps: Heat a large wok or deep frying pan over medium-high heat with 2 tsp of the oil. Pour in the eggs and stir gently for about 1 minute, until just set in soft pieces. Tip onto a plate.

Turn the heat to high and add the rest of the oil. Add the spring onion whites, carrots, red pepper and cabbage and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, until the cabbage has wilted and the pepper is softening.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir for 30 seconds, until fragrant, then add the peas and sweetcorn and stir-fry for 2 minutes, until they are hot and bright.
Add the rice, breaking up any clumps, and spread it over the pan. Leave it for 2 minutes without stirring so it toasts, then toss and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes, until every grain is piping hot.
Pour the soy sauce and sesame oil over, return the egg, breaking it up, and add the spring onion greens. Toss for 1 minute until evenly coloured, taste and serve straight away.
prepNote: Cook the rice a day ahead, spread it on a tray to cool fast, and keep it covered in the fridge.
